name: K239 Chunmoo
armament: Two interchangeable pods: 2x20 131 mm, 2x6 239 mm guided (80 km), 2x4 CTM-MR or 2x1 CTM-290 tactical missile
protection: Armoured cab against small arms and splinters. Game: armoured cab/hull immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and larger penetrate and can disable it; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Four-axle 8x8 truck with a flat-fronted armoured cab; Polish Homar-K on a Jelcz 8x8 chassis
Two large rectangular rocket pods side by side on a rotating rear launcher
Reload crane on the launcher; paired with a K239T reload truck carrying four pods
